# Notices for components bundled inside JSZip

The bundled `jszip.min.js` is upstream JSZip 3.10.1. This project uses JSZip under its MIT option; its complete original dual-license notice is retained in `JSZIP-LICENSE.md`. The existing browser bundle also contains pako, lie, immediate and setImmediate. Their upstream notices are retained below. No helper library was newly added for this release.
